name: digilite-hub
description: DigiLite Hub — fleet, rider and ad management for DigiLite LED bags

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: concurrently -n db,api -c blue,green "node scripts/pocketbase.mjs serve" "npm run start -w server"
scripts.check: npm run check -w shared && npm run check -w server && npm run check -w web
